community_list_entries.name: EvolMem: A Cognitive-Driven Benchmark for Multi-Session Dialogue Memory

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Multi-session dialogue memory benchmark (1,600 dialogues, ~6.8 sessions each) covering declarative (retrieval, summarization, isolation, inference, reproduction) and non-declarative (learning, habituation) abilities. Its 'Learning' ability (operational-rule internalization, ARC-style) is borderline
